challenge.results: On Windows 11 (win32, 10.0.26300) with Python 3.13.5, the new 7,048-byte LICENSE had SHA-256 a2010f343487d3f7618affe54f789f5487602331c0a8d03f49e9a7c547cf0499. Text output and dry-run preview matched the input bytes, and the preview created no file. Add refused the preexisting file and preserved its contents. It refused notice substitution parameters and a same-length mutation of the bundled input. The Python socket guard check passed. All seven checks matched the reference observation, with no unexpected failures or mismatches.

limitations: The result covers the pinned revisions, publisher representation, command, scratch fixture and runtime. Other environments and installation options require separate evidence.

The guard blocked Python socket events in the tested CLI. Operating-system network isolation was untested.
Authority to dedicate a particular work and redistribution rights require separate evidence.
